run_RPG_model: run the RPG recommendation model on the AmazonReviews2014 dataset using the main entry point
run_model_with_checkpoint: run a trained model from a checkpoint path on a specified dataset
run_custom_model_dataset: run any genrec model on any dataset by passing --model and --dataset flags
parse_args_function: parse command line arguments for model name, dataset name, and checkpoint path
run_pipeline_with_configs: run a genrec Pipeline with additional command line config overrides
